summary: Both round-1 majors are fixed and confirmed: the triglyceride values sum to 15.1 so the mean is 1.68 mmol/L (median 1.3 unchanged), and the relative-risk step now says 75% higher risk (probability), notes RR is not an OR, and the stated OR of about 2.1 is correct ((21/49)/(12/58) = 2.07). I also re-derived the RR 1.75 CI (0.93 to 3.28) and p = 0.08, and the t-test CIs and p-values in both inferential worked examples; all are consistent. I recomputed every numeric key in all 16 units (sample sizes, design effect, inclusion-exclusion, retention months, word budgets, percentages, NNT/RR) and all keys and tolerances are correct, and each MCQ has exactly one correct option. No critical or major problems remain; the 10 minor round-1 consistency and clarity items were not changed and still stand, plus one new minor LaTeX escaping defect introduced by the hand fix. This is an AI review only: the course still needs a subject-matter expert (research methods and biostatistics) before clinical or engineering reliance.

issues.problem: In the corrected triglyceride worked example the step latex field is stored with single backslashes ("\bar{x} = \frac{15.1}{9} = 1.68\text{ mmol/L}"). In JSON, \b, \f and \t decode to backspace, form-feed and tab characters, so the formula will render corrupted (other latex fields in the lesson use doubled backslashes).
issues.suggestedFix: Store the field with escaped backslashes: "\\bar{x} = \\frac{15.1}{9} = 1.68\\text{ mmol/L}".

issues.problem: Categorical worked example answer: "Most students preferred morning study time", but morning is 14 of 36 (38.9%), a plurality not a majority.
issues.suggestedFix: Say "The largest group (38.9%) preferred morning study time".

issues.problem: Key and explanation call d = 0.70 a "moderate effect"; by Cohen's conventions 0.5 is medium and 0.8 large, so 0.7 is medium-to-large. The stem gives no p-value although option c refers to "the p-value alone".
issues.suggestedFix: Say "a medium-to-large point estimate", keep the emphasis on the wide CI, and optionally reword option c.

issues.problem: Stem has 8 tutorial groups of about 10 students (about 80 students) but the adjusted sample to plan is 407, which that pool cannot supply. The arithmetic (DE 1.27, 406.4 to 407) is correct.
issues.suggestedFix: Reword to "tutorial groups of about 10 students, with enough groups available" or raise the cluster count to about 41.

issues.problem: Abstract-rewrite worked example answer: Background says "Sleep or teaching interventions may affect short-term performance" though the study is on hand-hygiene teaching and quiz scores; "although the sample was small" is placed in Results, and no result numbers are given.
issues.suggestedFix: Background: "Short teaching sessions may improve hand-hygiene knowledge in medical students." Move the small-sample caveat to the Conclusion.

issues.problem: Table row says CONSORT covers "Randomised controlled trials and other intervention trials"; CONSORT is for randomised trials (non-randomised evaluations use TREND). PRISMA, SPIRIT, CARE and ARRIVE appear as distractors without being introduced.
issues.suggestedFix: Restrict the CONSORT row to randomised trials and add one line naming PRISMA, SPIRIT, CARE, ARRIVE and TREND.

issues.problem: The Boolean formula ends with "\setminus C" but C is never defined and NOT is elsewhere discouraged. Worked example 1 says the outcome block is kept "only if important for precision" yet the string includes delirium.
issues.suggestedFix: Define C as the NOT block or remove it; reword the step to say the delirium block is optional or why it is included.

issues.problem: Option c) is "PubMed" while the stem asks for a source "in addition to PubMed", so it is not a plausible distractor.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace option c with another plausible source (for example Embase alone) or reword the stem.

issues.problem: q001 and q006 use "Measurement gap" as a distractor, but the lesson table names the fourth gap type "Methodological gap".
Worked example asks for "two specific objectives" but the steps list three numbered objectives and the answer gives two (baseline and compare merged).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the steps and answer both show two objectives, or ask for three.

issues.problem: Stem treats the ten-minute slot as 8 minutes speaking plus 2 minutes questions, whereas the lesson word budget, objective and q002/q006 treat the ten-minute talk as 10 minutes of speaking.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the time structure, for example state that the talk is 10 minutes plus separate question time.
